notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
[img]https://pp.vk.me/c626327/v626327378/18e3/xv_AfIxCBr0.jpg[/img]

[h1]We are welcome you to the third global update of "Heroes of Scene"[/h1]

[b]New features and changes[/b]

[b]1) New characters and spell[/b]

"Clown"
Clown deals double damage to enemy heroes that have less than 150 max HP.
• Characteristics: 250 health and 15 attack.
• Cost: 30 wood, 10 mana, 150 cloth.

"Knight"
Gets +50% to his attack damage from enemy hero's attack damage that he's fighting
• Characteristics: 250 health and 20 attack.
• Cost: 40 wood, 15 mana, 200 cloth.

"High Prices!"
Enemy cards will be more expensive by 50% for 15 sec.
• Cost: 30 mana

You can buy all cards from the new update in the special card pack into the game-store.

[b]2) Balance changes[/b]

Spells:

"Lightning"
• Earlier: Deals 70 damage to enemy hero
• Now: Deals 80 damage to enemy hero

• Earlier: Cost mana is 110 
• Now: Cost mana is 110 

"Restoring"
• Earlier: Restores 60 health to your gates
• Now: Restores 75 health of your gates

• Earlier: Cost mana is 25
• Now: Cost mana is 30

"Magic needle"
• Earlier: "Flies across the stage, deals 30 damage to all heroes"
• Now: "Flies across the stage, deals 40 damage to all heroes"

• Earlier: Cost mana is 100
• Now: Cost mana is 130

Heroes:

"Vacuum"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 15, Cost mana is 35, Cost cloth is 100
• Now: Cost wood is 15, Cost mana is 25, Cost cloth is 90

"Teddy"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 40, Cost mana is 40, Cost cloth is 380
• Now: Cost wood is 50, Cost mana is 25, Cost cloth is 390


"Ripper"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 10, Cost mana is 25, Cost cloth is 80
• Now: Cost wood is 5, Cost mana is 20, Cost cloth is 75

"Mayor"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 15, Cost mana is 45, Cost cloth is 250
• Now: Cost wood is 15, Cost mana is 45, Cost cloth is 225

"Jester"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 10, Cost mana is 20, Cost cloth is 100
• Now: Cost wood is 10, Cost mana is 20, Cost cloth is 90

"Catapult"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 200, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 15
• Now: Cost wood is 190, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 15

"Samarui"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 40, Cost mana is 20, Cost cloth is 55
• Now: Cost wood is 35, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 50

"Scary"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 20, Cost mana is 10, Cost cloth is 140
• Now: Cost wood is 15, Cost mana is 10, Cost cloth is 130

"Pinocchio"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 225, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 30
• Now: Cost wood is 230, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 30

"Headgehog"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 5, Cost mana is 5, Cost cloth is 70
• Now: Cost wood is 5, Cost mana is 5, Cost cloth is 65

"Koshey"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 30, Cost mana is 45, Cost cloth is 370
• Now: Cost wood is 50, Cost mana is 50, Cost cloth is 400

"Robot"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 145, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 120
• Now: Cost wood is 150, Cost mana is 15, Cost cloth is 120

"Legionary"
• Earlier: Cost wood is 20, Cost mana is 10, Cost cloth is 155
• Now: Cost wood is 20, Cost mana is 10, Cost cloth is 145

[b]3) Remake AI for training mode[/b]

AI has been completely redesigned. Now it uses different cards and strategies adapting to the situation on the stage.

[b]4) Changes in the gameplay[/b]

• The Crossbow is now be  attack automaticly.
• Browsing all  card collection is available now.
• The Gate`s health  is now updated immediately.
• The prices of the card slots has been chanched.
• The bug with the opening-closing gate has been fixed.
• The Vacuum CLeaner`s animantion has been fixed.
• The speed of action camera has been reduced on iOS devices. 
• The maximum of the resources are displayed red now. 

[b]5) Other changes[/b]

• The problem with matchmaking has been fixed.
• The bug with language switch has been fixed.
• The grafical bug with chat has been fixed.
• Fixed bug with windows download and expectations of the enemy in a battle.
• The problem with download and loading window has been fixed.
• The bug with resolution switch has been fixed.
• The bug with graphic  switch has been fixed.
• Fixed the bug with the particles on ultra settings.
• Fixed problems on Andriod 6 and iOS 9. 
• We have changed the names of ‘’Collsections’’ and ‘’Puppeteer`s license’’ on ‘’Cards’’ and • • ‘’Premium Account’’  respectively.
• We have chanched the description of the lasts improvments in the forge and workshop.
• The button of the store has been changed.
• The button of opening-closing gate has been replaced.
• The card sale button has been changed.
• The improving button in the forge and the workshop has been increased by size.


Thanks you all for support!

notes.title: Welcome to the 1.2 update
notes.notes:
[img]https://pp.vk.me/c628727/v628727407/219c5/bKP8R_-cIyU.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the second global update in our game. We have been  added some new characters and skills. And also we have been done  ​​numerous improvements and bug fixes  in the interface and gameplay.

[h1][b] Main[/b] [/h1]

•  The speed of the characters has been increased.
•  Keep an eye on the new Top Score Board.
•  The e-mail snap has been added to the new version.


New characters and spell 

[b] Samurai[/b] 

Samuai is cheap and has a long range attack. It`s perfect for supporting your heroes on the initial stage of the game. 

Features:
• 70 health
• 15 attack

Requires:
• 40 wood
• 20 mana  
• 55 cloth

[b] Legionnaire[/b] 

It`s excellent in opposition to a huge crowd of opponents. Every enemy`s character  gets +1 to its protection.

Features: 

• 170 health
• 20 attack

Requires:
• 20 wood
• 10 mana
• 145 cloth

[b] Mole.[/b] 

New active skill is available. This spell is an excellent means to eliminate rag heroes.  since the duration depends on the amount of tissue in the value of the hero - than its larger, the longer the mole will operate.

Requires:
• 60 mana

[h1][b] Game Shop[/b] [/h1]

•  We have been changed the policy of the gaming  store. You can now buy cards collection  by  silver, but in this regard we have been  increased their value in gold. 
•  The third card collection  of new characters is now availiable  -  we have been added two new characters, and one spell. 

[h1][b] Changes in the game processes[/b] [/h1]

•  The “market” construction has been changed. Now it has only one level instead of five.
•  Now the game won`t be closed with an error if you have a large number of cards.
•  Delete button in the "Attic" is finally fixed. 
•  The bug  with the chat during the fight has been fixed. 
•  The bug with the crossbow has been fixed.



[h1][b] Few words about the training mode[/b] [/h1]

•  The bot in the tutorial mode has been enhanced. We made ​​the enemy-PC a little more interesting and tricky.
•  The enemy bot has been weakened in training mode .
•  When you exit window training now  you can enter the battle in the search without any bugs.

[h1][b] User interface [/b] [/h1]

•  We have been added a  list of news. Now you'll be aware of all the events of the game.
•  The new inscription at the end of the battle.
•  We have increased the area of the card insertion slot and changed the speed of the insert in order to make the interface more smoothly.
•  The inscription "In the process of" in the smithy and builder`s shop windows has been fixed.
•  The new button of exit has been added to authorization window.
•  We have been modified the invitation window to a duel.

[h1][b] Other errors[/b] [/h1]

•  Now you can`t enter the game without any cards. 
•  The bug  with Russian symbols has been fixed.
•  If you change the resolution  camera won`t extend beyond the edge of the stage.
•  Fixed bugs in the menu and pre-battle window on screens with  ratio  21: 9.
•  Logging in to the game on Linux and OS X  works properly now.

notes.title: Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Players!
We are working on the game so hard and now we are ready to give you good news. This updates fixed most bugs and corrected balance of cards

- Fixed a bug with a crossbow
- Fixed a bug with deleting of buildings
- Improved chat and added chat spam-filter
- Fixed subtraction rate after win
- Fixed a bug which let disable sabotage effect using buildings improving
- Corrected an improvement cards
- Improved performance of the server and fixed most causes of disconnects.
- Fixed some problems with registation.
- Fixed achievements"Wizard" and "Lord"
- Fixed "waiting for opponent" screen when you use two same cards.
- Сorrected in-app purchases
- Redesigned order of looting cards (more drops in multiplayer mode)
- Improved matchmaking. Now it uses more strong rank border.
- Added a warning that the enemy surrendered
- Added a loading screen after registration
- Fixed some problems on Linux.
- Added new sounds

Balance:
Koshey: +10 to cloth price. -5 to demage
Robot: +20 to cloth price. +5 to wood price
Catapult: +10 to wood price
Mayor: -5 to cloth price
Reaper: -5 to cloth price
Teddy: +15 to cloth price
Magic needle: +5 to mana price
Magic bubble: +5 to mana price
Sabotage: +10 to mana price
Box: +10 to mana price

The game still works badly on Mac and some antivirus still blocks connection with the server but we will also fix it soon.

Thank you!
